study: Transient wake persistence, shedding and fluctuation screening
solver: OpenFOAM v2512 pimpleFoam SST kOmega URANS
mesh_method: Native mirrorMesh about Y=0, same geometric resolution, full aircraft
velocity_convection: Gauss limitedLinearV 1 (unbounded continuity form for transient solve)
perturbation: Localized lateral U perturbation of amplitude 0.1 percent of freestream; initial-condition seed only, no continuing forcing
scope: URANS modeled large-scale wake, not LES/DNS; generic unpowered public geometry, no prism layers, no validated stall limit. Full domain allows asymmetric evolution. Persistence cannot be inferred from startup alone.
acceptance: Finite fields and stable Courant/continuity; discard startup; inspect block stationarity, force/probe fluctuations and timestep sensitivity before frequency claims.
